lines.text: Southern League in 1975. FA Cup winners in 1988.
No goalkeeper had saved a penalty in an FA Cup final until Wimbledon's Dave Beasant in 1988.
Dave Beasant had studied John Aldridge's penalties on television all season. The save was homework.
In 1975 Southern League Wimbledon held Leeds United nil all after Dickie Guy saved a Peter Lorimer penalty.
In 1982 to 83 Wimbledon won the Fourth Division with 98 points, a record under three points for a win.
Dave Bassett, the defender whose knee knocked Wimbledon out in 1975, built the team that won in 1988.
Which club from the bottom of the pyramid would you most like to see lift a major trophy?
